title: 1 Magnus vs ∞ Pawns
summary: Player has only a king and one pawn vs the Magnus bot; each turn the player makes a move AND gains a pawn to place anywhere except the back rank. Game 1: quick aggressive pawn chains with an f7 drop/check idea mate in very few pawns ('only took us three pawns'). Game 2 (self-imposed): try to capture all of Magnus's pieces first, then mate; player runs the king around, walls up weaknesses, promotes, and keeps giving checks to win again, nearly forming a 'pawn cube'.
rules: White: king + one pawn; black: full army (Magnus bot ~2850).
Each player turn: make a normal move, then place one pawn on any empty square EXCEPT the back rank (rank 8) - to prevent dropping promotions.
Game 2 extra self-challenge: remove all Magnus's pieces before mating (not a rule of the engine).
win_condition: Checkmate Magnus. Video: won both games.

opponent.name: Magnus (chess.com Magnus bot)

evidence: Transcript 0:01 'I start with only one pawn and gain one pawn each move, which I can place anywhere'; 0:22 'placed anywhere on the board except for the back rank because then I would just be dropping promotions'; 2:06 'we do in fact win the game number one'; 2:11 'get rid of all of Magnus's pieces and then try to checkmate him'; 9:32 'we do in fact defeat Magnus with infinite spawning pawns'.
